intro: Webwood Spider Silk is a fine, sticky thread harvested from Webwood Lurkers prowling the woods of Teldrassil. While spider silk has many craft uses, these particular swatches are sought out by suspicious figures in the boughs of the World Tree.

p: Spun by the overgrown Webwood Lurkers that nest around Dolanaar, Webwood Spider Silk is light, remarkably strong, and dangerous to harvest. The satyr Zenn Foulhoof, who lurks along the forest road, hires young adventurers to harvest swatches of this silk alongside nightsaber fangs and strigid owl feathers. Claiming they are simply rare reagents necessary for his forest business, he relies on the naivety of newcomers to gather the wild components without questioning his corrupt nature or his true motives.
